ℹ️ Codes and rates are from Lebanon's official customs tariff book — always double-check anything important against the original document.
⚠️ Built-in data (5,379 codes) is extracted from the official Lebanese Customs tariff book ("تعريفة الرسوم الجمركية وفقاً للنظام المنسق", Majlis al-A'la lil-Jamarik, 2012 4th amendment), with updates applied throughout: VAT shown as 11% (the book's legacy 10% rate, updated per current rate — a further rise to 12% has been proposed but was not yet confirmed in effect), a flat +3% tax on every code that carries VAT (not limited to any particular chapters) — VAT-exempt codes never carry the +3% — and a new Environmental Tax (الضريبة البيئية) per Law No. 38 (effective 5 January 2026, amended 20 August 2026), shown as its own chip ranging from 0.1% up to 3% of customs value depending on HS chapter/heading per the current official rate table; unlike the +3% tax, it applies regardless of VAT/duty status and is collected by Customs the same way as duty. Automated text-extraction from a 640-page PDF can still contain occasional errors, especially in the hierarchical description context — the duty/VAT % and the "Tariff book p.N" reference on each result are the most reliable fields; use the page number to cross-check the original PDF before filing anything consequential. Go to the Import Data tab to load an updated official file if you have one. The blue 🛂 Permit chip flags HS chapters/headings that Lebanon's Ministry of Economy and Trade and Ministry of Public Health name as requiring prior approval from a specific ministry before import (sourced from their published non-tariff-measures documentation) — it is a heads-up, not a complete list of every restricted category, so always confirm with the relevant ministry or your customs broker.
Try: laptop · سيارة · sayyara · or a code like 851712. Typing Arabic in English letters? Tap the word chip that matches what you meant.
Lebanon's exchange rate moves — this is an editable estimate, not a live feed. Check today's official/customs rate and update it here if it's changed. This one rate applies to every item below.
Estimate only. Each rate (duty, VAT, extra tax, environmental tax) is applied as a flat percentage of the higher of your invoice value or the official statutory minimum customs value (when a quantity is entered for a code that has one on file). This doesn't account for exemptions or trade-agreement preferential rates, and doesn't include shipping/insurance/broker fees. Always confirm the final figure against the current tariff book and customs valuation rules before filing.
